_note: Constants of the energy model in scripts/experiments/energy.py that are not simulator inputs. The DRAM energies (row cycles, array accesses, transfers, refresh, background) are derived from the DDR5 device currents below; the energy coefficients of the PE operations and the DIMM-level buffers are the *_pj_per_* keys of config/pim/bitacc_runtime_default.json.

host.source: Assumed host power: 65 W while the host executes its own operations (embedding, LM head, sampling) and 10 W while it waits for the DIMM; 0 W and 20 W bound the idle power in the sensitivity study. These are assumptions of the paper (Section 6, Energy), not measurements.

pe_leakage.source: bank_pe_w, dimm_pe_w: leakage power of one bank-level PE and of the DIMM-level PE logic, Synopsys Design Compiler pre-layout synthesis with the ASAP7 7-nm RVT TT library (paper Table 'Area and power'). dimm_buffers_w: leakage of the 6+2+2 KiB DIMM-level buffers, CACTI organization model scaled to 7 nm with published FinCACTI ratios (same table).

ddr5_device.source: Micron, 16Gb DDR5 SDRAM Addendum MT60B4G4/MT60B2G8/MT60B1G16 Die Revision D (16gb_ddr5_sdram_dierevD.pdf, Rev. F 04/2024). Currents: maximum limits of Table 8 (DDR5 IDD, IPP, IDDQ Current Limits) for the x8 device at DDR5-5600: one-bank activate-precharge IDD0/IPP0, precharge standby IDD2N/IPP2N/IDDQ2N, active standby IDD3N/IPP3N/IDDQ3N, burst read IDD4R/IPP4R/IDDQ4R, burst write IDD4W/IPP4W/IDDQ4W, all-bank refresh IDD5B/IPP5B/IDDQ5B. Voltages: VDD = VDDQ = 1.1 V, VPP = 1.8 V (nominal, Features). page_bytes: 1KB page of the x8 device (Table 1, 16Gb Addressing). t_rp_ns: tRP = 16.000 ns of the DDR5-5600 (46-45-45) part (Table 2). t_ras_ns: tRAS(min) = 32 ns of the DDR5 speed bins, so that tRC = tRAS + tRP = 48 ns. The same device is used for every model configuration, although the simulated organizations are 8-Gb to 32-Gb DDR5-3200 devices.
